item.description:
Release v5.1.3

Changes since v5.1.2

  • feat(ActivityHeatmapPlugin): add caching support for activity heatmap data
  • feat(AgentTurnRunnerPlugin): persist outgoing requests to disk (SwiftData) and add settings view
  • feat(ClipboardManagerPlugin): enhance clipboard functionality
  • feat(DockerManagerPlugin): add container health check support
  • feat(GoalTaskPlugin): enhance goal task tracking functionality
  • feat(LLMProvider): add plugin category for all LLM providers
  • feat(LumiPlugin): add willSendToLLM hook for pre-request message modification
  • fix: move testTarget to proper position in Plugin Package.swift files
  • fix(ChatScreenshotPlugin): minor improvement
  • fix(LumiFactory): update plugin service dependencies
  • fix(MessageSenderPlugin): improve message sending logic
  • refactor: change DockerManagerPlugin category from developerTool to development
  • refactor: rename ChatAttachmentPreviewPlugin → ConversationAttachmentPlugin
  • refactor: update plugin ordering and remove dead code
  • refactor(IdleTimePlugin): remove status bar item and improve ActivityHeatStrip view
